regions.text: でなくてはならない。そこに學間の部門獨立と學體系の段階組織との基礎が存してるる。またそこに一部門内の學勢作の具體性現質性の保證も存してるる。

quote.translation: Here lies the foundation of the independence of the departments of science and of the graded organisation of scientific systems, and here too lies the guarantee of the concreteness and actuality of scientific labour within a single department.

regions.text: 單なる同一化單なる必然化は一切の汝一切の個然性を否定することによつて無宇宙論へ導く。

quote.translation: Mere identification, mere necessitation, leads by negating every thou and every contingency to acosmism.

regions.text: 理論的認識の到達すべき理想は單なる必然性であつてはならない。偶然を滿喫し偶然性に他和された「偶然ー必然者」でなければならない。

quote.translation: The ideal that theoretical knowledge should reach must not be mere necessity; it must be a "contingent-necessary entity" that has its fill of chance and is saturated with contingency.

regions.text: いつたい偶然性の時間性格が直態としての現在である限り必然的思催の方法論證系としての論理學に對して偶然性が非合理性として現はれるのは異とするに足りない。

quote.translation: Insofar as the temporal character of contingency is the present as immediacy, it is no wonder that contingency appears as irrationality for logic as the methodological system of necessary thought.

regions.text: しかしながら、論理約規定を汝の直接性に即して出發させ、汝」の内面化に學勞作の理念を捉へることは論理そのものに生命を衛らし、盛問に具體價値を賦與する所以である。

quote.translation: Yet to let logical determination set out from the immediacy of the "thou", and to grasp the idea of scientific labour in the internalisation of the "thou", is the means by which life is brought to logic itself and concrete value conferred on science.

regions.text: 「我＝我」なる思惟の同一性の預域と「我」による「汝」の體驗の直接性とを出水得る限り緊密の關係に保ち、必然と偶然とを不可分離の相關に於て接綱せしめることは、生の論理擧へ適進する理論前質存にとつて公理的要求でなければならない。

quote.translation: To keep the domain of the identity of thought, "I = I", and the immediacy of the "I"'s experience of the "thou" in as close a relation as possible, and so to bring the necessary and the contingent into contact in an inseparable correlation, must be an axiomatic demand for theoretical Existenz as it presses on towards a logic of life.
